purpose: Record completed local source-context field extraction for the seventh C2 long-tail source-extraction queue, covering cancer-control, survivorship, transplant-safety, organ-donation and bioengineered organ-replacement continuity domains while preserving 404 route, duplicate-source, registry-route, guideline-lineage and model-admission blocks.

currentLimitations: This register records local field extraction only; it does not complete local source-context review or independent fresh review.
FDA HCT/P and xenotransplantation routes with local HTTP 404 probe results are retained as source-resolution/manual-route issues, not reviewed evidence.
Duplicate CDC transplant-safety rows must be handled as duplicate source lineage during local review and cannot be counted as independent evidence twice.
Public pages, news posts, guideline routes, recommendation pages and PDFs are kept in their source-context roles and do not authorize individual clinical advice or calibrated model parameters.

sourceAccessNotes: All 24 C2-LT-B7 candidate source rows were locally checked on 2026-07-03 against NCI, CDC, COG, USPSTF, ODPHP, AASLD, PMC, ASGE, Donate Life or FDA routes before field extraction.

Local probe returned normal HTML/PDF access for 20 rows, a dynamic 202 registration route for Donate Life, and HTTP 404 for three FDA guidance/index URLs; the three FDA rows are explicitly marked source-resolution required.
CDC transplant-safety guidance appears twice with different domain roles; the register marks the second occurrence as duplicate-source-route context to prevent evidence double counting.
USPSTF negative or shared-decision recommendations are preserved as boundary/falsifier evidence, not converted into broad screening claims.
All rows are source-context support only; page availability or PDF access does not admit calibrated model parameters, individual predictions, clinical advice or intervention rankings.

extractedRows.sourceTitle: National Standards for Cancer Survivorship Care
extractedRows.exactClaimUse: Can support source-context framing that survivorship care requires standards for comprehensive, person-centered post-treatment care, including surveillance, late-effects management, psychosocial support, health promotion and care coordination.
extractedRows.endpointDefinition: Candidate endpoints include survivorship-care-plan presence, late-effects monitoring, recurrence or second-cancer surveillance, psychosocial function, transition coordination and post-treatment follow-up continuity.
extractedRows.populationOrSetting: Cancer survivors after diagnosis or treatment across oncology and primary-care transition settings; standards-level framing rather than a trial effect estimate.
extractedRows.effectOrMechanismSignal: Mechanism signal is care-continuity and risk-management: structured survivorship care can reduce missed follow-up, unmonitored late effects, psychosocial deterioration and care handoff failure.
extractedRows.uncertaintyOrBias: Standards context does not quantify survival gain, recurrence reduction or individual functional-life extension; implementation quality and cancer type remain heterogeneous.
extractedRows.transferBoundary: Transfer only to survivorship infrastructure, care-coordination and endpoint-definition work; do not use as evidence that a specific survivorship intervention extends lifespan.
